I replied to Hollis in the #central-team thread: the signed paperwork puts Marrow Agrisupply at 40 seats.

- **What the contracts say:** the affiliate amendment (signed 2 Oct 2025) set 40 seats. The 2026 renewal (signed 22 Apr 2026, running 1 May 2026 to 30 Apr 2027) states that it leaves Agrisupply's seats unchanged. The Marrow Agrisupply account notes, last updated 15 Sep 2026, also say 40.
- **The conflict:** Tobias's 382-seat message from 14 Oct doesn't match any signed document I could find. I pointed that out to Hollis and suggested he check with Tobias or June (deal desk) whether there's newer paperwork before changing the sheet. Until then, 40 is the documented figure.
- **My earlier reply:** when Tobias posted the 382, I said "noted" without checking it against the contracts. That made it look as if I'd accepted the number, which I shouldn't have.

The shared file folders showed me nothing for this account, so the contract details came from the knowledge brain's copies. Seat counts and dates aren't restricted, so it was fine to post them to the Central team. I left out the per-seat price, since only finance and the account owner may see prices.
